scenes.line1: Can you use your site without a mouse?
scenes.say: Ever tried using your site with just a keyboard? Why is keyboard navigation so important for accessibility?

scenes.label: Keyboard
scenes.sub: Users must reach and use every interactive element.
scenes.say: Keyboard accessibility means users should be able to reach and use every interactive element without a mouse.
When you open a modal, move focus to it. When you close it, return focus to the element that triggered it. Always check that tabbing follows a logical order.
Here's how you use tabindex minus one to focus a modal when it opens, and return focus to the trigger when it closes.

scenes.question: What happens if focus isn't managed?
scenes.wrong: Users just tab to the next element.
scenes.right: Users can get lost or stuck, making the UI unusable.
scenes.say: If you don't manage focus, users can get lost or stuck, making your interface unusable for keyboard-only users.
